claims.quote: The access panel at the back was a hair ajar; when I peered in the brass looked thumbed and raw where varnish had been rubbed away. There were fine, fresh scores around the latch—hairline marks that caught the light as if someone had used a slender tool to lever it open.
claims.value: fresh tool marks and hairline scores around latch

claims.quote: At the base the black thread hung where I'd seen it: waxed, stiff, caught on a small screw. This time I followed its line with my gaze. It wasn't a loose scrap that had wandered into the case; the thread looped and ran up toward the movement, vanishing behind the plates.
claims.value: thread looped and ran up toward movement, vanishing behind plates

claims.quote: "I was in three days ago to wind it and I stripped the weight-gear to clean the pivots—it's delicate work, Ellis."
claims.value: admitted servicing clock three days ago to wind and strip weight-gear to clean pivots

claims.quote: The scrap, though, sat on that halo without a smear. If he'd clutched the paper in his last moments it would have been different—the fibres would have been pressed, ink and blood mingled into the edge. This looked staged.
claims.value: inference: torn note placed after death (fibres lying on top, no blood transfer)

claims.quote: "We lifted a partial print from the flap's crease," he told me without flourish. "Preliminary lift consistent with Iris Harben."
claims.value: partial latent print lifted from diagonal crease on flap; preliminary lift consistent with Iris Harben

claims.quote: "If he sells it, we have nothing left but his arrogance."
claims.value: Iris said: If he sells it, we have nothing left but his arrogance.
